rules.statement: An order of abatement entered under section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code, when subsequently set aside, does not revive the lis pendens during the period between the passing of the order and its being set aside.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion, where there is no diligent prosecution as so defined, and the Court passes an order for the abatement of the action, the lis pendens is thereby determined. This is in accordance with the whole scheme of the Code, which has in view the speedy and final determination of all litigation..."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code
